name: hbm_sfu_programme_store_r8_1017

pin_regs.reason: the RTL (ot_hgi_sfu_programme_store_r8) registers every input in a PURE pin flop (no reset/logic in front of D; r7c4 native capture FAIL on cfg_we fixed) and every output (io_word/compiler_control/status/fault output registers) at the boundary, per OWNER RULE 19:50; a kit-level flop stage would add a redundant edge to the split latency the equivalence receipt prices

structural_change: r8 (H-SU 2026-10-17; successor of r7c4 route hbm_sfu_programme_store_r7c4_1016-r7c4-a686d9aa7 CLOSED TT +30.58 / FF +7.18 but NATIVE FAIL capture 222.0 ps > 190 on cfg_we, results/arch/hbm_sfu_store_1016/native_audit_r7c4.json): RTL ot_hgi_sfu_programme_store_r8 = r7c with pure input pin flops (r7c reset-ANDed r_cfg_we / r_io_cfg_we / r_io_start_v in front of D); reset qualification on 3 kept relays BEHIND the pin flops, strobes bit-identical to r7c on every edge; 0 added cycles (io_word / compiler_control D = 4, status 2, host config >= 4 edges after rst_n release), +3 relay flops. Fully synchronous regional reset tree unchanged (2-flop sync -> 3 region -> 12 stripe/pin relays, no async clear, data regs unreset). Geometry: H-DIE granted slot 820.8 x 734.4 (d4f sfus_<q>, square-ish 1.12:1; r7c4 447.12 x 1023.84 was 2.3:1). 22 SRAMs in 3 columns x 2 abutted N-S stacks (stack origins on the 43.2 um lattice: x 129.6 / 345.6 / 604.8, y 43.2 / 388.8; in-stack pitch 70.512 = height + 0.042, on track): col A R0 = IO calendar (main pins face the W register band), col B MY + col C R0 = programme calendar pairs (main pins face one shared 84.5 um logic channel); one contiguous std-cell region = W band 129.6 um + channels 41.3 / 84.5 / 41.3 um joined by S 43.2 / mid 63.6 / N 63.6 um E-W corridors (the only E-W routing past the M1-M4 macro OBS). Pins (exact io_tcl, tools/hbm_static/sfu_store_r8_pins.py): W io_word + compiler_control evenly over 6..728 um (3.07/um, M4) with clk + rst_n at the W centre (y 366.9 / 367.2) next to the W register band; N west half programme cfg/start/status + fault, S west half IO cfg/start/status (M3, 0.87/um); E empty. Clock: one spine root (14.3k sinks, macros as spine leaves: r7c4 measured macro late <= 8.5 ps); no hybrid raw macro entries (direct_macro_clock_entries needs one exclusive port per SRAM = 22 ports > the 8 granted, and the measured macro skew needs none). Kit RECIPE 4 / hold_budget die (flop-first pins, no in/out hold pads).

job.purpose: SFU programme store r8 (both fixed SFU calendars, 11 stripes x 2 pages = 22 ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256) for die slot sfus_<q> 820.8 x 734.4 (H-DIE grant 10-17 01:50): pure input pin flops for native capture (r7c4 cfg_we 222.0 ps), checklist-compliant square-ish floorplan, exact face pin plan.
